title: feat(list): Filter · Sort · Display · Search toolbar, width-fitted view tabs, one leading row cell, one-row page header
body:
Fixes #12423

Clause-②: yes

The console list page gives less of the screen to chrome: four controls on the toolbar with everything else in one Display panel, view tabs fitted to the width, one leading cell per grid row, and a one-row page header. The scope note on the card thread (comment 6184810876) is applied: no favorite star in the header, the current tab's menu is unchanged, and the default-view star moves from the tab into that menu.

## What changed

**A. View row** (`@object-ui/plugin-view`, `ViewTabBar`)
- The visible tab count is derived from the strip's width. Every tab is drawn and measured before paint (a layout effect), the ones that do not fit fold into the existing "N more" menu, and a `ResizeObserver` re-fits from the remembered widths. The active-in-tail swap and the `view-tab-overflow*` test ids are unchanged. The current tab's ▾ menu button is part of its measured width.
- `maxVisibleTabs` is now an optional cap on top of the width (no default). The pure fit is exported as `fitVisibleTabCount`.
- A grid/list tab shows its label alone; other types show the icon the host maps to them, and none when the host maps none.
- The per-tab filter/sort micro-icons are removed, in the strip and in the overflow menu. `hasActiveFilters` / `hasActiveSort` stay on `ViewTabItem` and draw nothing. `ViewTabBarConfig.showIndicators` is marked deprecated because it no longer draws anything.
- The default-view star on the tab is removed. The tab's "Set as default" entry, in both the dropdown and the context menu, now shows the state: a filled star, a trailing check, and `aria-current` on the default view. Rename, the context menu and inline rename are unchanged.

**B. Toolbar** (`@object-ui/plugin-list`)
- `compactToolbar` now defaults on. This is decided where `toolbarFlags` is derived: `schema.compactToolbar !== false`. The bar shows Filter, Sort, Display and Search, in that order, with the existing count chips on Filter and Sort. New test ids: `toolbar-filter-trigger`, `toolbar-sort-trigger`.
- Display is the existing `ViewSettingsPopover`, relabelled `list.display` and extended. Its rows, in order:
  - a Layout row (the existing `ViewSwitcherDropdown`, only when `viewSwitcherOffered`)
  - Group, Row color and Hide fields
  - Density (gallery card density on a gallery)
  - a Row numbers switch
  - an Edit inline switch, which keeps the test id `toolbar-inline-edit-toggle`
  - a footer with Reset to view default, Refresh (`refresh-button`) and Export
- The trigger (`toolbar-display-trigger`) shows a count chip (`toolbar-display-count`) with the number of settings that differ from the view's own. Radix supplies `aria-expanded` on the trigger. Both switches are `role="switch"` with `aria-checked`.
- Persistence is unchanged. Each control writes through the same door as its wide-form button, and Reset writes back through those doors too. Row numbers is `useState(true)` in `ListView` and is never stored. Nothing new goes to storage, localStorage or a preference slot.
- `compactToolbar: false` keeps the wide form, one button per control.

**C. Grid rows** (`@object-ui/components` data-table, `@object-ui/plugin-grid`)
- A selectable data-table now draws one leading cell per row.
  - It shows the row number by default. It shows the checkbox on row hover, on focus-within, on a coarse pointer, and on every row while any row is selected.
  - The swap is done with CSS classes on one fixed-width cell. Nothing mounts or unmounts, and the checkbox is hidden by opacity only.
  - The header keeps select-all. With row numbers off, the cell is blank until hover.
  - Sticky offsets and colSpans count one leading cell.
- The row-actions trigger (data-table's own, and plugin-grid's `RowActionMenu`, which is the console grid's actual row menu) shows on row hover, focus-within, a selected row and an open menu. It is hidden by opacity only, never `display: none`.
- `ObjectGrid` takes a `showRowNumbers` host prop. It is on unless a host says off, and is never read off the node. `ListView` passes the Display switch through the `SchemaRenderer` host props.

**D. Page header** (`@object-ui/app-shell`)
- `PageHeader` is one row from `sm` up: icon, title (h1), a hairline divider, then the description as a truncated sibling paragraph, with the actions on the right. Below `sm` nothing changes.
- The list page no longer passes the favorite star. The managed-by badge stays inline with the title.

**E. i18n:** `list.display`, `list.layout`, `list.rowNumbers` and `list.resetToViewDefault` are added to all ten packs. The three keys only the old panel read (`list.viewSettings`, `list.viewSettingsHint`, `list.recordEditingTitle`) are removed from all ten packs.

**Docs:** the `@object-ui/plugin-list` README and `content/docs/components/complex/data-table.mdx` are updated. The changeset is `.changeset/12423-list-page-display.md`, minor for each of the seven touched published packages.

## Decisions and deviations (please read)

- **Leading-cell scope.** Card item C.6 is taken literally: the swap applies to every selectable `data-table`, not only the console grid. That includes "blank until hover" when row numbers are off. On a touch screen (coarse pointer) the checkboxes stay visible. The `selectionStyle` retirement docs and its zod refusal message said checkboxes are always visible, which is no longer true. They now say there is no authored style and describe the table's own reveal.
- **Edits outside the claimed file surface.** Each one is needed to keep shipped text or behaviour true:
  - `packages/types`: the `compactToolbar` default, the `ViewTabBarConfig` docs, the `selectionStyle` / `showRowNumbers` / `cellClassName` docs, the zod tombstone message, and one test comment
  - `packages/plugin-grid/src/components/RowActionMenu.tsx`: without it, C.7 does nothing in the console
  - the docs listed above
  - test files in plugin-list, components and app-shell
- **`useFavorites` in the console's ObjectView.** The scope note says "the `useFavorites` wiring in `ObjectView.tsx` stays". Measured: the star button was that file's only reader of the hook (one call, three uses, all inside the button). Keeping the call would leave unused bindings, so the call, its import and the now-unused `appName` binding were removed. The hook, `FavoritesProvider`, the record page, the sidebar and the home page are untouched.
- **Display-panel defaults.** "The view's default" is what the host handed the list in `schema`. In the console, density and hidden fields persist back to the view, so they stop counting once that write returns. Grouping's default is the list's seed, which is the view's own grouping or the one a shared link carried.
- **Removed hint.** The old panel's hint ("Applies to everyone who uses this view") is removed. With Row numbers (session-only), Layout and grouping (URL) in the panel, it would no longer be true.
- **Wide-form test pins.** Twenty-one plugin-list test files that drive a wide-form button now spread `WIDE_TOOLBAR = { compactToolbar: false }` into their fixture. Spreading it first lets a fixture that sets the key itself win. Console-level tests (app-shell) instead go through the Display panel, the console's default path.
- **Diff size.** About 2.26k changed lines (1752 added, 507 removed), above the roughly 1.5k estimate and below the 2.5k stop line. Most of the excess is those intentional test-pin updates.

## Acceptance notes

- The view-tab row and the toolbar stay two rows. Card items A–F do not ask to merge them, and `ListView` has no slot for the tabs. If the prototype meant one row, that needs its own card.
- `view.activeFilters` and `view.activeSort` were already dead keys before this branch: the removed indicator tooltip spelled its words in English and never read them. `node scripts/check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs` lists both as confirmed. They are left in place. Carrier: none.
- `packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/entryRegistersBuiltinDesigners-11939.test.tsx` failed in two loaded multi-package runs, at 1011 ms against its 1000 ms `vi.waitFor`. It passed alone at the same head. Its timed window covers the entry's dynamic import of the designers chunk, which this diff does not touch. This is the load-timing class AGENTS.md describes under the test discipline section. Carrier: none.
- Browser check at 1440, 1024 and 390 px is the seat's step, per the scope note. No backend was run here.
- `origin/main` has moved three commits since the base (fc528c3). `git merge-tree` against it is clean; the overlapping file is `ObjectView.tsx`.

The one failure is the designer-registration timing note above; alone at `4ba299c` it reads `Tests 1 passed (1)` |

Run at `56bd0ab`; `4ba299c` adds only the changeset and two docs files. Dependency closure built first and checked: each package's `dist` carries this change's markers |

New tests:
- `ViewTabBar.widthFit-12423` covers six of eight views and "2 more", the swap-in, the `maxVisibleTabs: 3` cap, the counted chevron, the no-layout case, icons on non-grid types only, no micro-icons, and the default state shown in the menu.
- `ListView.displayPopover-12423` covers exactly four bar buttons by test id, the named absences, the `compactToolbar: false` control, the Display contents, the Layout row only when a switch is offered, `aria-expanded`, the count chip at 0 → 1 → 0 through density and Reset, and the Row numbers switch reaching the grid.
- `data-table-leadingCell-12423` covers number with no visible checkbox by default, every checkbox once one row is selected, select-all always present, blank-until-hover, and the row-actions trigger in the DOM for every row and hidden by opacity.
- `PageHeader.oneRow-12423` covers one h1 with the description as a sibling in the same flex row.

Local runs cover the dispatch's targeted subset. `pnpm lint`, the full `pnpm test` and the rest of the farm are CI's.
